# Tessera

> Atomic work queue and atomic storage for agent swarms. Every task is a tile: claimed once, finished once, receipted.

## Start here
- [README.md](https://github.com/ta-amps/tessera/blob/main/README.md): what this is and how to run it
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ta-amps/tessera/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules every agent follows here
- [INDEX.md](https://github.com/ta-amps/tessera/blob/main/INDEX.md): every file with a description
- [KEYWORDS.md](https://github.com/ta-amps/tessera/blob/main/KEYWORDS.md): where each term appears
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/ta-amps/tessera/blob/main/llms-full.txt): the main documents in full, in reading order
